column1: # SPY-QQQ COUPLING: the anchor vector for the satellite equity leg (`satBeta`/`satIdio`),
# which JointCouplingSuite / joint_coupling_tests re-derive from this file. Editing a graded
# row moves the shipped test bands. Measured from Yahoo Finance's daily history (adjusted closes,
# daily simple returns, inner-joined) over 1999-03-10..2026-08-31; the w1993 rows read the
# Nasdaq-100 index (^NDX, price only) against SPY from 1993-01-29, for the longer window.
# Conventions (one codebase measured both this record and the model's grading):
#   corr        Pearson correlation of daily simple returns
#   volRatio    daily vol ratio, satellite / primary
#   beta        OLS beta of satellite on primary daily returns
#   residShare  1 - corr^2: share of satellite variance the primary does not carry
#   residStressCalm  residual vol, stress / calm, conditioned on the PRIMARY's trailing 21d
#               vol including the session (calm <= p50, stress >= p80 within the window)
#   corrFlatVol / corrFlatDd  corr(stress) - corr(calm) under the vol conditioning above and
#               under drawdown conditioning (primary <5% vs >10% below running peak). The
#               NEGATIVE anchor: correlation is state-flat BECAUSE idio vol rides the shared
#               state (7.7 -> 23.7%/yr calm to stress); a mechanism with constant idio noise
#               manufactures a stress-correlation kick this pair does not have.
#   roll60*/beta252*  rolling 60d correlation and 252d beta distribution percentiles
#   residKurt/residA20  kurtosis and |resid| lag-20 autocorrelation of the OLS residual --
#               the idio component is itself market-like, not gaussian-iid
#   perYearCorrSd  population sd of the calendar years' correlations
# THE DEPTH ROWS read both legs AT THE RECORD WINDOW'S DRIFT: each leg's own realized log
# drift is replaced by refDriftPrimary / refDriftSat (SPY's and QQQ's over the window, a
# year), and d5Ratio / d10Ratio are the satellite's share of sessions more than 5% / 10%
# below its running peak over the primary's, crashRatio its count of 15%+ declines over the
# primary's. The w1999 rows are the window at its own drift; the bNNNN rows are its
# non-overlapping 5-year blocks, each re-drifted to the window's. The d5 / d10 bands are the
# range of the window and its blocks rounded outward to 0.1. Re-drifting sets aside the
# relative drift between the legs, which the rel-trend rows grade; it removes the world's
# own long-run drift from the depth rows, which otherwise rise 0.035 per 0.01 of it.
# THE DIMENSIONLESS RULE. ratio = beta / corr identically, so (beta, corr) are the free
# anchors and the satellite's absolute residual vol follows the MODEL's own primary vol:
# resid = beta * sigma1 * sqrt(1/corr^2 - 1) -- 12.1%/yr at the model's 16.4, where this
# window's 14.1 belongs to SPY at 19.2%. Same philosophy as the depth rungs: grade each
# The `tol` column is the twins' test band half-width (median of 4 model paths, 100y, daily
# simple returns, default seed family). Rows with `-` are documentation and grading-time
# anchors (the python grader over -jointemit output owns the distribution and conditioning
# rows, and the depth rows' bands are derived as above); nothing else is fitted from this file.
